newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy records provisional BOP surplus in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Italy records provisional BOP surplus in 1996.

text.p: Italy's overall balance of payments recorded a provisional 19.602 trillion lire surplus in 1996 against a 1995 surplus of 2.910 trillion, the Bank of Italy said in a report.
BALANCE OF PAYMENTS (In billions of lire)
The data showed bank capital movements gave a 1996 deficit of 43.511 trillion lire against a 1995 deficit of 58.102 trillion.
Non-bank capital movements registered a surplus of 32.961 trillion lire in 1996 against a 1995 surplus of 51.539 trillion.
Italian capital outflows totalled 82.664 trillion lire against 32.924 trillion in 1995, while foreign capital inflows amounted to 115.625 trillion lire against 84.463 trillion in 1995.
